description: Fresh installed C/C++, Java/Kotlin collections, recursive Cargo/Python and existing Ruby collection/callable regressions after Ruby gem graph integration. Earlier receipts retain their original hashes. An independent pre-integration worktree establishes that Ruby collection native libraries are unchanged by this milestone; only the private Ruby API and shared process/Ractor guards change installed files.
